reply_text:
I answered Tobias in our direct message: on Oct 14 he told me his standing call with the Marrow Agrisupply team is Thursdays at 10:45 from now on. I took that from the note I saved in gbrain, the only matching record. Nothing newer replaces it.

One thing to check: gbrain stored that note with visibility set to "world", even though I wrote down that it came from Tobias's private message. It didn't affect this answer, because Tobias was the one asking. But it might mean the brain shows the note to other people, which would break the rule that a direct message stays with that member. I won't repeat it to anyone else either way. It may be worth limiting the note to Tobias, or deleting it with `forget`.
